summary: Run dashboard server shutdown on a bounded helper thread so Ctrl+C teardown of koru auto up --web always returns

delivery.outcome: koru auto up --web interrupt teardown stops the background dashboard within a bounded ~2s join instead of deadlocking inside BaseServer.shutdown()
nonGoals: No change to dashboard serving, routes, SSE/WS streaming or port selection
No change to autonomous cycle logic, queue behavior or autopilot daemon lifecycle

architecture.decision: Keep _shutdown_web_dashboard as the teardown owner but move server.shutdown()/server_close() onto a helper daemon thread joined with a 2s timeout; the koru-serve-bg serve thread is already a daemon and keeps its bounded join
architecture.rollback: Restore inline server.shutdown()/server_close() calls in _shutdown_web_dashboard and drop the regression tests

validation.evidence: Dashboard and serve suites stay green
